Hi, I'm the data manager for the ONCO2026 Phase III oncology trial. We just received the raw laboratory results file from our central data collection system. It's a CSV called `lb_raw_onco2026.csv` and it's sitting in the `project_data/trial_ONCO2026/raw/` folder.

Our regulatory team needs this lab data cleaned and formatted for FDA submission by end of day. I know there are problems in the file: some dates are in different formats (we got data from multiple sites with different systems), there are a handful of extreme lab values that look like transcription errors (some glucose and hemoglobin values are wildly out of range), and there are some missing result fields from Site 003 where the analyzer had an equipment failure.

Can you clean this file using the clinical data cleaning tool we have available? For the extreme values, please use the clinical range-based approach rather than a purely statistical one — our medical monitor insists on clinically meaningful thresholds. Flag the suspicious values rather than deleting them (we need to review them). For the missing numeric results, fill them in using the median. The output cleaned file should be called `lb_clean_onco2026.csv`.

Please make sure there's also a proper audit record generated alongside the cleaned data — our regulatory submission requires complete traceability of all changes made during cleaning.
